title: Palisades Recreation Center – Approval of (i) Proposed Donation from PPRC
text:
Palisades Recreation Center – Approval of (i) Proposed Donation from PPRC
  Development Project, LLC for the Repair and Restoration of the Palisades
  Recreation Center Baseball Field Damaged by the 2025 Palisades Fire; and (ii)
  Donation Agreement – Suspension of the California Environmental Quality Act
  Pursuant to California Governor's Executive Order N-4-25 (as Amended)
summary: Approval of donation from PPRC Development Project, LLC for repair and restoration of Palisades Recreation Center baseball field damaged by the 2025 Palisades Fire.

details.action: approval of donation for field repair and restoration
